questionsForUser: The model now follows each cabin's own official photos: THE Suite walls neutral, THE Room half cool, economy cool. Premium economy is the odd one: its two official photos (py_37301, py_37302) show the same cool cast as economy, but the model keeps its ceiling and bins neutral. Should premium economy be cooled to match its photos, or should the whole aircraft share one white balance?
